rules.subtitle: What earns or costs members credits: when it happens, how much, and how often.
rules.heading: Rules
rules.fromNow: A rule applies to what happens from now on, never to past events.
rules.deleteWarning: Credits the rule already paid stay, and are still taken back if their content is hidden. Nothing more is paid by it.

form.triggerHelp: The event the rule reacts to. Several rules may share an event; each applies on its own.
form.triggerFixed: The event of a rule cannot be changed. Create another rule for another event.
form.forumsHelp: Tick the forums the rule is limited to. None ticked means every forum.
form.amountHelp: Positive pays the member, negative charges them. It cannot be 0.

adjust.subtitle: Give or take credits by hand, with a reason that goes in the ledger.
adjust.balanceUnknown: The balance is not shown to you (it needs permission to read the ledger).
adjust.amountHelp: Positive gives credits, negative takes them. Taking more than the member has leaves a negative balance.
adjust.amountProblem: Enter a whole number that is not 0.
adjust.confirmDescription: Nothing has changed yet. The ledger row cannot be edited or removed afterwards.
adjust.beforeAfter: When this page was loaded the balance was {before}; with this adjustment it would be {after}.
adjust.noLedger: No ledger rows for this member yet.

notices.adjustedBalance: Credits adjusted. The balance is now {balance}.

awards.subtitle: The awards members can hold: their category, what they are worth, and when they are given automatically.
awards.heading: Awards
awards.description: In the order of the awards page: by category, easiest first. Inactive awards are shown too.
awards.runHelp: Checks every member against every active award that has criteria. It also runs by itself every day.
awards.runQueued: The check was queued and will run shortly.

revoke.heading: Take back awards from members who no longer qualify
revoke.help: Goes through the automatic awards members hold and takes back, with its XP and credits, each one whose rule the member no longer meets. Awards given by hand are never touched and members are not told. Count first: nothing changes until you take them back.
revoke.progressCount: Counting: {percent} of the members looked at. So far {grants} grants held by {affected} members would be taken back.
revoke.progressRevoke: Taking back: {percent} of the members done. So far {grants} grants taken back from {affected} members.
revoke.failedCount: The count stopped at {percent} on an error: {error}
revoke.failedRevoke: Taking back stopped at {percent} on an error: {error} Nothing is lost: resume it and it goes on from there.
revoke.doneCount: Counted {members} members who hold automatic awards: {grants} grants held by {affected} members would be taken back, {xp} XP and {credits} credits.
revoke.doneNone: Counted {members} members who hold automatic awards: everyone still meets the rules.
revoke.doneRevoke: Done: {grants} grants taken back from {affected} members, {xp} XP and {credits} credits, out of {members} members who hold automatic awards.
revoke.count: Count what would be taken back
revoke.revokeWarning: {grants} grants held by {affected} members will be revoked, taking back {xp} XP and {credits} credits (a balance can go below zero) and lowering their levels. Members are not told. It runs in the background, a few members at a time, and can take a while; this page shows how far it is. Awards given by hand are not touched.
revoke.countQueued: The count was queued and will start shortly.
revoke.revokeQueued: The run was queued and will start shortly.
revoke.notQueued: A run is already under way.

form.tierHelp: Only the colours of its round icon: bronze for the easy rungs up to legendary for the hardest. Its name is never shown to members.
form.xpHelp: Added to the member's total with each grant. Grants already made keep the XP they were made with.
form.creditsHelp: Paid to the member with each grant.
form.pictureHelp: A wide picture shown behind the award's card. Upload a new one to replace it.
form.iconHelp: The glyph in the award's round icon. With no icon the default medal is drawn.
form.stackableHelp: The same member may be granted it any number of times. Otherwise once.
form.activeHelp: An inactive award cannot be granted and is hidden from members.
form.basicsHelp: What the award is called, where it is listed and what each grant is worth.
form.automaticHelp: Criteria that grant the award by themselves. With none, it is only given by hand.

form.name: Name
form.pictureHelp: Shown in the shop. Without one, the icon of the effect is shown.

effectHelp.permission: Grants a permission for as long as the item is held. It adds to what the member's groups grant; a “never” anywhere still denies it. Selling a permission needs the permission to manage permissions as well.
effectHelp.group: Adds a secondary group while the item is held: this is how paid ranks are sold. Never a consumable. Selling a group needs the permission to manage permissions as well.
effectHelp.frame: Unlocks an avatar frame for as long as the item is held. The member then wears it or not.
effectHelp.nameColor: Unlocks a name colour for as long as the item is held. The member then wears it or not.
effectHelp.nameIcon: Unlocks an icon next to the member's name for as long as the item is held. The member then wears it or not. Never a consumable.
effectHelp.threadCover: Used on a thread the member started: gives it the chosen cover.
effectHelp.highlight: Used on a thread the member started: lists show it highlighted for some days.
effectHelp.bump: Used on a thread the member started: it sorts as if it had a new post.
effectHelp.promote: Used on a thread the member started: it is featured for 24 hours and shown on the home page, and listed first in Trending while it is among the 10 newest features (an older one is listed only where it ranks). Sold in units; nothing is refunded if the thread is deleted later.
effectHelp.usernameChange: One unit pays for one change of username.

form.noFrames: The frame catalog has no active frame with a picture. Add one under Appearance.
form.noCovers: The thread cover catalog has no active cover with a picture. Add one under Appearance.
form.iconHelp: The icon drawn beside the member's name.
form.noColours: The name colour palette has no active colour. Add one under Appearance.
form.groupHelp: The guest group and groups at or above your own rank cannot be sold.
form.groupTyped: The list of groups is not shown to you: type the id of the group.
form.permissionHelp: The permissions of the admin category cannot be sold.
form.permissionTyped: The list of permissions is not shown to you: type the id of the permission.
form.permissionValueHelp: A whole number, -1 for unlimited. Leave empty for a yes/no permission.
form.permissionValueHelpUnit: A whole number of {unit}, -1 for unlimited.
form.permissionFlag: This is a yes/no permission: holding the item grants it, so there is no value.
form.daysHelp: How many days a thread stays highlighted after one use.
form.consumableLabel: Sold in units, used up one at a time
form.consumableHelp: Unticked, the item is bought once and held (for a duration if you set one).
form.consumableForced: A username change or a promotion is sold in units, so the item must be a consumable.
form.consumableBarred: A group item is never a consumable: it applies while held.
form.durationHelp: How long the item lasts from purchase. Leave empty for permanent.
form.stockHelp: Units left to sell. Leave empty for unlimited.
form.giftableHelp: Members may buy it for another member.
form.positionHelp: Where it comes in its category. Lower numbers come first.
form.activeHelp: An inactive item cannot be bought and is hidden from members.
form.basicsHelp: What members see in the shop and what it costs.
form.effectGroupHelp: What the item does once it is bought, and whether it is used up or held.
